subject: Aureon Labs — staged acceptance & billing path for private offers
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aureonlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aureon Labs — staged acceptance & billing path for private offers

Hi Sofia — great conversation yesterday. Per our request from procurement, I pulled together a short staged acceptance playbook so your finance and engineering teams can see the handoffs for a Private Offer (GCP private offer with optional AWS fallback). Attached: a first-draft MAP workbook and an eval task list.

Topline proposed sequence (high level):
- Week 0: Internal sign-off (SOW/PO intent) + Redwood sends Private Offer link (GCP)
- Week 1–2: Technical eval (connectivity, perf smoke tests) — engineering checkpoints + prefix caching test
- Week 2–3: Acceptance criteria runbook (latency SLA, token-cost sanity check, sample workload pass/fail)
- Week 3–4: Finance issues PO -> Redwood issues invoice per agreed billing path (monthly invoice with net-30)

Notes / asks for your team:
1) Can you confirm the approver for the PO in finance (name + email)?
2) Are you open to an AWS fallback private offer if GCP quota or timeline becomes an issue? (we can route at request time)
3) Please review the attached MAP and mark any internal milestones you want added.

I looped Kimberly to double-check billing options (our marketplace vs. private offer invoicing) and Jordan to coordinate the acceptance checklist.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute alignment call if helpful.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Aureon_MAP_v1.xlsx; Aureon_Eval_Tasks.pdf

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aureonlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@aureonlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aureon Labs — staged acceptance & billing path for private offers

Thanks Karthik — received and reviewed the playbook. Quick answers:
- PO approver: Ben Carter (ben.carter@aureonlabs.com), Head of Finance — he copied me on this reply.
- AWS fallback: yes, we prefer GCP but want the option if there are quota constraints or pricing delta > 12%.

A few comments from my side (see inline in the MAP workbook):
- Add a security review gate between technical eval and acceptance (SOC 2 evidence plus network diagram).
- For the technical eval, can Redwood provide a short perf script (containerized) we can run in our staging project?

Happy to do a call on Monday with Ben and engineering to finalize the timeline.

— Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Procurement Manager | Aureon Labs

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@aureonlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aureonlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2029 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aureon Labs — staged acceptance & billing path for private offers

Karthik / Team — looping in Finance approval. We reviewed terms internally; a couple of items before I can issue formal PO: 
1) Confirm Redwood’s invoice recipient and remit address for the private offer invoice (we need a legal/finance billing contact and tax details)
2) We prefer monthly consolidated invoices rather than per-deployment invoices. Can you confirm Redwood can aggregate usage under the Private Offer billing path?
3) I’ll need to see the security evidence pack (SOC 2 Type II summary + data residency notes) before acceptance gate.

If you can provide the perf smoke script and the security pack today, we can keep to the Week 1–3 timeline; otherwise we’ll slip a week.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Finance | Aureon Labs
Attachments: N/A

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@aureonlabs.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@aureonlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aureon Labs — staged acceptance & billing path for private offers

Ben — thanks, noted. Short answers and next steps: 
1) Billing contact: billing@redwood-inference.com; Redwood remit: Redwood Inference, Inc., 320 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107. Tax/EIN in attached redline (Private_Offer_Terms_redline.docx).
2) Aggregated monthly invoice: yes — we support a consolidated invoice for private offers. Kimberly, can you confirm the invoice grouping and whether we need a special Marketplace orchestration step?
3) Security pack: attaching SOC 2 summary and a short data residency note. Also attaching the perf smoke script as a small containerized test (instructions in the Aureon_Eval_Tasks.pdf).

Proposed immediate cadence to keep to target close:
- Tomorrow (Tue): Aureon runs perf script in staging; Redwood provides live support during 10:00–12:00 PT window.
- Wed: Security gate checklist completed by Aureon (SOC 2 doc verified) + engineering signoff on perf numbers.
- Thu: Ben issues PO intent; Redwood prepares invoice routing.
- Next Mon: Go-live acceptance window and handoff to CS for onboarding.

If that schedule works, I’ll update the MAP workbook with exact dates and post back a DocuSign link for signature.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Private_Offer_Terms_redline.docx; SOC2_Summary.pdf
